name: codex-jev
description: Per-line Jev filtering across local text, test/build, and search/listing tool results.

interface.longDescription: Codex Jev adds three optional local PostToolUse filters for eligible plain-text tool results. A Rust hook classifies local command and tool output into general, test/build, or search/listing routes, then asks TypeSafe AI's Jev for independent per-line probabilities in bounded batches. Code protects diagnostics and exact evidence, and uncertain or unsupported results remain intact. Every shortened result points to a private, exact original. Filters start disabled and require a TypeSafe API key. The optional VS Code control and version-pinned composer patch are installed separately. This package contains a Linux x86_64 hook binary; other execution environments need their own native binary.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up Codex Jev for test logs.
Check whether this Jev-shortened result kept the evidence I need.
